name: branch-appointment-booking
description: Full-stack branch appointment booking system (Node.js/TypeScript, Express, SQLite, React)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
